name: position
notes: Adds where each player plays, derived from their statistical profile. Midfielders are 29% of the players and take 66% of the votes; defenders are 36% and take 9%. Position dummies and position-by-statistic products let the model say that twenty-five disposals is a remarkable game from a defender and an ordinary one from a midfielder. Best of any scenario at naming a club's leading vote-getter.
